# Dataverse Skill Bundle

Microsoft's supplied plugin tree has no standalone `dataverse` plugin. This directory is a convenience copy of:

`code-apps/skills/add-dataverse/`

The skill is located at `skills/add-dataverse/SKILL.md`; its relative reference files are under `skills/add-dataverse/references/`, and the Code Apps shared guidance it links to is under `shared/`.

The canonical bundled copy remains inside `code-apps/`. Keep this extracted copy synchronized when refreshing the vendor snapshot. The skill can create or extend Dataverse schema, so follow its approval and environment safeguards before any live changes.
